answer: Continuous retraining on live operational data exposes a machine learning system to poisoning attacks because an attacker may inject malicious samples into the data during operation. This adversarial contamination of the training data can disrupt or influence the retraining process, leading to a model that underperforms or behaves unpredictably. The risk arises from the fact that the model is being updated with data that may have been compromised, which can result in the model learning from flawed or harmful data.
